take: Toronto announced that John Tavares was activated from injured reserve and goalie Artur Akhtyamov was recalled from Toronto (AHL). Tavares played 9 games this season with 2 goals and 7 points, but the Leafs controlled just 34.5% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, and their share was 13.5 points better without him. The 8-9-2 Leafs, at 46% in the same measure, get a third-line center on the first power-play unit back. We have no numbers on Akhtyamov.
